description: S459 MED-2 legitimate twin of ssr-seed-refused-keeps-initial-rt: the seeded rows satisfy `R[]` (n = 5), so the seed is applied to the refined server-authority cell, the next cell is seeded, and boot wires the handler. Guards the refusal path against over-refusing.
rationale: §52.8: server-authoritative variables are pre-rendered and the client receives the pre-rendered value. §53.3.3: the assignment is applied if and only if the predicate evaluates to true.
